title.narrative: ''SEMED MSME Financial Inclusion Programme''

description.narrative: The objective of the Programme is to improve financial inclusion for MSMEs in Egypt, Jordan, Morocco and Tunisia (SEMED region) in a sustainable manner. That is to improve the ability of MSMEs to access appropriate financial services and products by expanding their opportunities for credit.The Programme will group the Organisations financing and assistance in three Instruments deployed for a better absorption rate for the EU-NIF contribution, maximise the funds leverage and provide a comprehensive package to enable the financial inclusion of MSMEs and the environment they operate in.
